sentences.text: I find no proceeding under the Act of 2006 has been instituted against the petitioner on the allegation of not having obtained any license under the Act.
Hence no legal right of the petitioner has been infringed as yet.
The writ petition is, therefore, dismissed as premature.
It is open to the petitioner to agitate all issues available to him in accordance with law in the event any proceeding is instituted against him under the aforesaid Act.

It is made clear that I have not expressed any opinion as to the merits of the plea of the petitioner,
which is kept open to be decided by the appropriate authority/Court in accordance with law, if occasion arises.
With the aforesaid observation, the writ petition is dismissed.
There will be no order as to costs.

(Joymalya Bagchi, J.)

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
------------
The petitioner is the office bearer of West Bengal Daspara Essential Commodities Traders' Welfare Association and has approached this Court, inter alia, for a declaration that they are not entitled to take license under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the Rules framed thereunder.
I find no proceeding under the Act of 2006 has been instituted against the petitioner on the allegation of not having obtained any license under the Act.
Hence no legal right of the petitioner has been infringed as yet.

which is kept open to be decided by the appropriate authority/Court in accordance with law, if occasion arises.
With the aforesaid observation, the writ petition is dismissed.
There will be no order as to costs.
